dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Man, it's hard to tell what time it is in this place without a view of the scenery outdoors to take cues from...

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: *sigh* Humans relax much more easily when they're surrounded by nature.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: So, don't stay cooped up in here forever, okay? You gotta go get some air once in a while.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Making productive use of your time is all well and good, but don't push yourself too hard, bro.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Always be mindful of your physical and mental state, and don't challenge yourself more than you can realistically handle.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: It's all about getting the balance right. Overexertion can be as detrimental as slacking off.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: I don't know many places as quiet as this. It's so peaceful here, *yawn* I'm starting to get sleepy...

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: But if I fall asleep now, I'll only mess up my circadian rhythm...

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Maybe I should find something to read. Any recommendations?
